description: This file provides helper functions for interacting with a Real Time Clock (RTC), including setting and getting time, converting date/time to string formats, and initializing RTC hardware.

methods.name: date_set_tm
methods.description: Sets the RTC time based on a provided 'struct tm' object.

methods.name: date_get_tm
methods.description: Retrieves the current RTC time into a 'struct tm' object.

methods.name: GetTimeUnixSec
methods.description: Returns the current RTC time as Unix timestamp.

methods.name: SetTimeUnixSec
methods.description: Sets the RTC time based on a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: put2
methods.description: Formats an integer value into a string buffer at a specified offset, ensuring two-digit formatting.

methods.name: dateToStringShort
methods.description: Converts current RTC date to a short string format if within valid range.

methods.name: dateToString
methods.description: Converts current RTC date to a detailed string format.

methods.name: printDateTime
methods.description: Logs the current RTC date and time.

methods.name: setDateTime
methods.description: Sets RTC date/time from a string representing Unix timestamp.

methods.name: initRtc
methods.description: Initializes the RTC hardware and tests RTC functionality.
